In WHO CNS5 (Introduction Section [8]), all MBs are considered to be CNS WHO grade 4.

In WHO CNS5, CNS WHO grade 4 is mentioned in the definition of SHH‐activated MBs [12,13] and in the text for WNT‐activated MBs [11]. However, no grade is mentioned for non‐WNT/non‐SHH MBs in either the definition or the text.

All other CNS embryonal tumors are assigned CNS WHO grade 4 [82,83,86].

No grade has been assigned to CRINET in WHO CNS5 [84].

ForBCORITD tumors, insufficient data currently exist to assign a CNS WHO grade [85].

Optional in WNT MBs.

with LC/A histology and/or

if IHC staining for p53 is negative (null staining)/focal/equivocal.
